const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/planner.py
+import json
+import math
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+N=256
+SIDE=227.185
+PAPER=np.array([.972,.957,.925],np.float32)
+
+def lab(a):
+    return cv2.cvtColor(np.asarray(a,np.float32),cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
+
+def palette():
+    inst=json.load(open('/app/instance.json'))
+    return np.asarray([w['rgb'] for w in inst['wells']['wells']],np.float32)
+
+def target():
+    im=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB'),np.float32)/255
+    im=cv2.GaussianBlur(im,(0,0),4.5)
+    return cv2.resize(im,(N,N),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
+
+def best_segment(v, minlen=5):
+    # v: lanes x N
+    cs=np.concatenate([np.zeros((len(v),1),np.float32),np.cumsum(v,axis=1)],axis=1)
+    # best start at least minlen before the current end
+    cand=cs[:,:-minlen]
+    mins=np.minimum.accumulate(cand,axis=1)
+    gains=cs[:,minlen:]-mins
+    j=np.argmax(gains,axis=1)
+    i=np.arange(len(v))
+    score=gains[i,j]
+    lane=int(np.argmax(score)); end=int(j[lane]+minlen)
+    start=int(np.argmin(cs[lane,:end-minlen+1]))
+    return float(score[lane]),lane,start,end
+
+def make_profile(radius):
+    z=np.arange(-math.ceil(radius*1.6),math.ceil(radius*1.6)+1)
+    # opaque interior, softly tapered edge
+    inner=radius*.65
+    outer=radius*1.30
+    p=np.clip((outer-np.abs(z))/(outer-inner),0,1)
+    return z,p.astype(np.float32)
+
+def paint(img,st,pal):
+    direction,lane,start,end,color,width=st
+    radius=width/2/(SIDE/N)
+    offsets,profile=make_profile(radius)
+    for d,a in zip(offsets,profile):
+        q=lane+int(d)
+        if 0<=q<N and a>0:
+            if direction=='h': sl=img[q,start:end]
+            else: sl=img[start:end,q]
+            sl[:]=sl*(1-a)+pal[color]*a
+
+def generate(nstrokes=449,log_every=25):
+    tgt=target(); tgtlab=lab(tgt); pal=palette(); plab=lab(pal.reshape(1,-1,3)).reshape(-1,3)
+    img=np.broadcast_to(PAPER,(N,N,3)).copy()
+    strokes=[]
+    lanesets={7.0:np.arange(2,N,5), 4.5:np.arange(2,N,3)}
+    profiles={w:make_profile(w/2/(SIDE/N)) for w in lanesets}
+    for step in range(nstrokes):
+        curlab=lab(img)
+        old=np.sum((curlab-tgtlab)**2,axis=2)
+        best=None
+        for k in range(len(pal)):
+            # Per-pixel gain of replacing current canvas by the well's colour.
+            g=old-np.sum((plab[k]-tgtlab)**2,axis=2)
+            for width,lanes in lanesets.items():
+                ofs,p=profiles[width]
+                # Desired mark has a soft margin. The scalar gain is a good
+                # ranking proxy; the update below uses the same margin.
+                ker=p[:,None]
+                gh=cv2.filter2D(g,-1,ker,borderType=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
+                gv=cv2.filter2D(g,-1,ker.T,borderType=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
+                for direction,values in [('h',gh[lanes,:]),('v',gv[:,lanes].T)]:
+                    score,li,start,end=best_segment(values)
+                    score/=math.sqrt(1+(end-start)/80) # leave room for local detail
+                    if best is None or score>best[0]:
+                        best=(score,(direction,int(lanes[li]),start,end,k,width))
+        st=best[1]
+        paint(img,st,pal);strokes.append(st)
+        if (step+1)%log_every==0 or step==0:
+            now=lab(cv2.GaussianBlur(img,(0,0),1.13)); t=lab(cv2.GaussianBlur(tgt,(0,0),1.13))
+            d=np.sqrt(np.sum((now-t)**2,axis=2))
+            print(step+1,'gain',round(best[0],1),'mean',round(float(d[9:-9,9:-9].mean()),2),'p90',round(float(np.percentile(d[9:-9,9:-9],90)),2),flush=True)
+    Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(img*255,0,255))).save('/app/output/mock.png')
+    np.save('/app/output/strokes.npy',np.array(strokes,dtype=object),allow_pickle=True)
+    return strokes,img
+
+if __name__=='__main__':generate()
*** End Patch";

+"""Generate the RoboPaint oil-paint trajectory for the frozen Asnieres instance.

+The stroke plan is computed by planner.py and stored in strokes.npy. The

+"""

+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np

+
+HERE=Path('/app/output')
+SIDE=227.185
+N=256
+
+def run():

+        generate()
+    strokes=np.load(strokes_path,allow_pickle=True)
+    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False)
+    s.reset()
+    p=s.primitives()
+    wells=s.wells()
+    start_time=time.time()
+    s.record_start()
+    current_color=None
+    failures=0
+
+    def go(x,y,z,speed=.24,settle=2):
+        nonlocal failures
+        info=p['move_tip']((x,y,z),speed=speed,settle=settle)
+        failures+=info['ik_failures']
+        return info
+
+    def point(u,v):
+        X=(u+.5)*SIDE/N
+        Y=(v+.5)*SIDE/N
+        return s.geo.mm_to_world(X,Y)
+
+    for i,st in enumerate(strokes):
+        direction,lane,start,end,color,width=st
+        lane=int(lane);start=int(start);end=int(end);color=int(color);width=float(width)
+        if current_color!=color:
+            wx,wy=wells[color]['center_xy']
+            go(wx,wy,.045)
+            go(wx,wy,.025,.08,3)
+            go(wx,wy,.045,.08,2)
+            current_color=color
+
+        if direction=='h':
+            x0,y0=point(start,lane)
+            x1,y1=point(end-1,lane)
+        else:
+            x0,y0=point(lane,start)
+            x1,y1=point(lane,end-1)
+        depth=.004 if width>7 else .003
+        down_z=.020-depth
+        go(x0,y0,.045)
+        go(x0,y0,down_z,.07,3)
+        go(x1,y1,down_z,.06,3)
+        go(x1,y1,.045,.08,2)
+        if (i+1)%25==0 or i+1==len(strokes):
+            print('painted',i+1,'/',len(strokes),'steps',s.n_steps,'dips',s.painter.stats['n_dips'],
+                  'ikfail',failures,'elapsed',round(time.time()-start_time,1),flush=True)
+    actions=s.record_stop()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions,HERE/'trajectory.npz',meta={'generator':'/app/output/gen.py','planner':'/app/output/planner.py'})
+    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(HERE/'painted.png')
+    np.save(HERE/'coverage.npy',s.ink())
+    print('status',s.status(),flush=True)
+    return s,actions
+
